However, alcohol can irritate your stomach lining and worsen acid reflux, making omeprazole seem less effective.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXtbyQuWIYnmJidebnGKIu6yHItUP69ZJhIXZIT8Er4xaSaDaXS3HXuwUi_MpD3frkDw11OlXcyQkkAU0BRqK_q0RC57iCRuTtib1ZDaKgwQXX67za0gVBr8moMP9fHjCfRaHF6RS-FMQoUg6v49wH)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXIXWLWGTHTu3Lxg0zPgNikHVVW63wRVXXk5qrBzS2urj1hpY4aLDO4eAvBmizyNp5YFmtXPfKu5JXK0Wu6_3OdqErL4UzZsEhTmE0u-Wk4-XW4ApxQC6GhyJwuzmaPupd)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXzCnyTKE6BPXtfSQTm39aDG5UDE5SNbU3m8wO0IHbxzLywnzHFV5qGANP7xOUtgPrr4leH9tGFvQ3wcHPcKKYXxQZLYS24iapnc2z4oA4kzlMGRGg5YP3n6VNUxFnP1zzPvsEvMh4pKOSlHXJnw)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjQEBxCJF1-vPAl4Z5tYcc09iLLHpVIjIexA70C-KCMuR4bpN7PVCedqHu7MU0WQ_l7pTDXiru0zi_GKPX2hYSEcyU0L0vlgF7AFilsmtxHvh7tZF9b6o43WTZeyhf3TKhGlQdFFS4ou12fmhQ4qPHwzTHFpDVsEeb_FN8mZGrudDvgeOplxS5DMdnzUZdSM)

### How Alcohol Affects Your Treatment

- **Worsened symptoms:** Alcohol increases stomach acid and relaxes the lower esophageal sphincter, which can trigger heartburn and reflux.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXzCnyTKE6BPXtfSQTm39aDG5UDE5SNbU3m8wO0IHbxzLywnzHFV5qGANP7xOUtgPrr4leH9tGFvQ3wcHPcKKYXxQZLYS24iapnc2z4oA4kzlMGRGg5YP3n6VNUxFnP1zzPvsEvMh4pKOSlHXJnw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXIXWLWGTHTu3Lxg0zPgNikHVVW63wRVXXk5qrBzS2urj1hpY4aLDO4eAvBmizyNp5YFmtXPfKu5JXK0Wu6_3OdqErL4UzZsEhTmE0u-Wk4-XW4ApxQC6GhyJwuzmaPupd)
- **Stomach irritation:** Drinking can aggravate underlying issues like gastritis, esophagitis, or stomach ulcers.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXtbyQuWIYnmJidebnGKIu6yHItUP69ZJhIXZIT8Er4xaSaDaXS3HXuwUi_MpD3frkDw11OlXcyQkkAU0BRqK_q0RC57iCRuTtib1ZDaKgwQXX67za0gVBr8moMP9fHjCfRaHF6RS-FMQoUg6v49wH)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjQEBxCJF1-vPAl4Z5tYcc09iLLHpVIjIexA70C-KCMuR4bpN7PVCedqHu7MU0WQ_l7pTDXiru0zi_GKPX2hYSEcyU0L0vlgF7AFilsmtxHvh7tZF9b6o43WTZeyhf3TKhGlQdFFS4ou12fmhQ4qPHwzTHFpDVsEeb_FN8mZGrudDvgeOplxS5DMdnzUZdSM)
- **Combination treatments:** If you take omeprazole alongside antibiotics (such as for *H. pylori* ), alcohol may interact with those other medications.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXtbyQuWIYnmJidebnGKIu6yHItUP69ZJhIXZIT8Er4xaSaDaXS3HXuwUi_MpD3frkDw11OlXcyQkkAU0BRqK_q0RC57iCRuTtib1ZDaKgwQXX67za0gVBr8moMP9fHjCfRaHF6RS-FMQoUg6v49wH)
- **Long-term or heavy use:** Frequent or heavy drinking alongside long-term omeprazole use can add stress to the liver and stomach lining.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiwEBxCJF17eqPYvpiR_6KiT34bfVF8fZ4cdvS9PpKoOPkNdz5p7dmykVQ0bh_LnMj3EpxxD-rqqY-c7WIZmc7TBlymjuRr0_Gb6PbafCC2yRuJmgZSebonHOkZYNMGyo9BrceBD0LDNKCLH1GFq_CuAA14Hsw5hRMDfIz-5HKLva-oTaHysl8w3pNjA0)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXzCnyTKE6BPXtfSQTm39aDG5UDE5SNbU3m8wO0IHbxzLywnzHFV5qGANP7xOUtgPrr4leH9tGFvQ3wcHPcKKYXxQZLYS24iapnc2z4oA4kzlMGRGg5YP3n6VNUxFnP1zzPvsEvMh4pKOSlHXJnw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjQEBxCJF1-vPAl4Z5tYcc09iLLHpVIjIexA70C-KCMuR4bpN7PVCedqHu7MU0WQ_l7pTDXiru0zi_GKPX2hYSEcyU0L0vlgF7AFilsmtxHvh7tZF9b6o43WTZeyhf3TKhGlQdFFS4ou12fmhQ4qPHwzTHFpDVsEeb_FN8mZGrudDvgeOplxS5DMdnzUZdSM)

### Practical Tips

- **Take omeprazole consistently:** It works best when taken daily before a meal (often 30 to 60 minutes prior), rather than taken sporadically right before drinking.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXIXWLWGTHTu3Lxg0zPgNikHVVW63wRVXXk5qrBzS2urj1hpY4aLDO4eAvBmizyNp5YFmtXPfKu5JXK0Wu6_3OdqErL4UzZsEhTmE0u-Wk4-XW4ApxQC6GhyJwuzmaPupd)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXtbyQuWIYnmJidebnGKIu6yHItUP69ZJhIXZIT8Er4xaSaDaXS3HXuwUi_MpD3frkDw11OlXcyQkkAU0BRqK_q0RC57iCRuTtib1ZDaKgwQXX67za0gVBr8moMP9fHjCfRaHF6RS-FMQoUg6v49wH)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXj3te_swkqJOg8Sb0H0cAMwqYYzsQneGjSjph6XLw9hddji1YmqQL5DdzKdH36K7NgkMXU6pUjHVIEfefKt_AO623Yb_O99uSqp67Qz8tyGSN8MLzzzTs168R4OBbAfMMsA)
- **Limit or avoid alcohol:** Skipping alcohol gives your stomach and esophagus the best chance to heal. If you do drink, keep it light and stop if you notice pain or heartburn.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHEIkXXMgQs7R3852eWVxwfWt7-v_e9HK5o7rg5xs-6rb04YcZB8_gVqIu_4tnoFhVuNWkCljmRsbOe4Rp_fRfDO8BKLcmOvjTv5xIAc9HSsOspetPabWJfJX4zYh8g6BXjig)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXtbyQuWIYnmJidebnGKIu6yHItUP69ZJhIXZIT8Er4xaSaDaXS3HXuwUi_MpD3frkDw11OlXcyQkkAU0BRqK_q0RC57iCRuTtib1ZDaKgwQXX67za0gVBr8moMP9fHjCfRaHF6RS-FMQoUg6v49wH)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXXtNPijy0kKhrJ2TFcX9B7MO7c47PvKg9EX3eX_6Vqn7sRI-EB48fhOfUma9iCdQxW50tsj0Mwcb_j7tSCFpwCJOrLDhaLDHeIVycYk2jpmdbH_r1BONH3hwHLUb7nYt-wmd2REa5Uw)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjQEBxCJF1-vPAl4Z5tYcc09iLLHpVIjIexA70C-KCMuR4bpN7PVCedqHu7MU0WQ_l7pTDXiru0zi_GKPX2hYSEcyU0L0vlgF7AFilsmtxHvh7tZF9b6o43WTZeyhf3TKhGlQdFFS4ou12fmhQ4qPHwzTHFpDVsEeb_FN8mZGrudDvgeOplxS5DMdnzUZdSM)
- **Watch your triggers:** Carbonated drinks, wine, and acidic mixers often trigger reflux more than plain spirits.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXzCnyTKE6BPXtfSQTm39aDG5UDE5SNbU3m8wO0IHbxzLywnzHFV5qGANP7xOUtgPrr4leH9tGFvQ3wcHPcKKYXxQZLYS24iapnc2z4oA4kzlMGRGg5YP3n6VNUxFnP1zzPvsEvMh4pKOSlHXJnw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmgEBxCJF19Ebh2UwNzu5AGkOT0rH69_X80ijjT9tkpnN9Tql9js1CKjh5YHqiTzL6JtPykdNvD5I9ksiPcd74zAhn9pMkjaxJGt4CJBXzBaeVAxoSlfo0tNDrqxWfFsWhfiOxnp6GzZtWFBlk5FOyh1Mj479aNunWzsIOn7ttDfck1mWJFMIWqSNFzwzDgy6kmqwBh8A0qZfREfM)
